examples.en: It is worthwhile to include really high-quality illustrations.
examples.zh: 把真正高质量的插图包括进去是值得的。

examples.en: These trees provide the raw material for high-quality paper.
examples.zh: 这些树是制造优质纸张的原料。

examples.en: More nurseries will be built to fill the need for high-quality child care.
examples.zh: 将建立更多的托儿所以满足高质量儿童保育的需要。
